title: DoRA, SpinQuant and adapter merging
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for Walsh-Hadamard outlier rotation quantization, weight-decomposed low-rank adapter analysis and subspace interference routing across static fusion and co-resident switching.
boundaries: FastWalshHadamardOutlierRotator applies orthogonal Sylvester Hadamard rotations over power-of-two channel dimensions and requires identical rotation seeds on inverse reconstruction.

SubspaceInterferenceAndMergeRouter recommends ties_static_merge only when both Frobenius cosine similarity and TIES sign-conflict density stay within configuration grid bounds; otherwise adapters remain separate under dynamic_co_resident_switch.
All quantization bit-widths, TIES trim densities, interference thresholds and numerical tolerances resolve from default_grid_spec.json and pass ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for Walsh-Hadamard outlier rotation quantization, weight-decomposed low-rank adapter analysis and subspace interference routing across static fusion and co-resident switching

value.lets_workers: Suppress heavy-tailed weight and activation channel outliers via orthogonal Walsh-Hadamard rotations with deterministic Rademacher sign flips before 4-bit symmetric quantization, decompose low-rank (B @ A) updates into directional unit vectors and column magnitudes (DoRA), and route multi-adapter pools between static TIES fusion and dynamic co-resident switching using Frobenius cosine and sign-conflict density thresholds.

flow.when: Apply Sylvester Walsh-Hadamard orthogonal rotation with deterministic sign flips and measure low-bit quantization MSE reduction against unrotated channel matrices.
Decompose low-rank adapter updates into column magnitude and unit-direction shifts and route adapter pairs between ties_static_merge and dynamic_co_resident_switch.
Independently verify orthogonal round-trip fidelity, 4-bit MSE reduction, TIES routing receipts and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Made-up 64-channel heavy-tailed outlier matrix, 4x4 DoRA probe and orthogonal/conflicting adapter pairs recomputed in test_adapter_quant_and_merge.py: SpinQuant Walsh-Hadamard rotation lowers max-to-RMS from 12.578755 to 2.166179, collapses excess kurtosis from 103.842906 to -1.034782, reduces 4-bit symmetric quantization MSE by 10.039322x (0.231252 -> 0.023035), decomposes DoRA directional/magnitude deltas (ratio 0.857493), and routes orthogonal adapters to ties_static_merge while routing sign-conflicting adapters to dynamic_co_resident_switch.

nouns.title: Guardrail: never statically fuse adapters whose Frobenius cosine or TIES sign-conflict density exceeds grid thresholds
nouns.category_reason: Prevents destructive parameter cancellation when combining conflicting task adapters.

value.rule: Route adapter pairs to ties_static_merge only when max_abs_frobenius_cosine <= max_cosine_for_static_merge and sign_conflict_density <= max_sign_conflict_for_static_merge; route interfering or sign-conflicting pairs to dynamic_co_resident_switch.
value.how_it_is_checked: SubspaceInterferenceAndMergeRouter.route_adapters enforces clamped grid bounds and unit tests verify dynamic_co_resident_switch on sign-conflicting adapters.

nouns.title: Guardrail: rotation radices, quantization bit-widths, TIES densities and interference bounds forbid inline scalars
nouns.category_reason: Keeps quantization and adapter-routing thresholds governed by externalized configuration grids.

value.rule: Operational Python functions and classes in adapter_quant_and_merge may only inline canonical mathematical identities (-1, 0, 1, -1.0, 0.0, 1.0); all bit-widths, trim densities and thresholds resolve from default_grid_spec.json.
value.how_it_is_checked: scan_directory_for_hardcoded_values and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.scan_paths scan every module in adapter_quant_and_merge during make check.

nouns.title: Specification: FastWalshHadamardOutlierRotator, WeightDecomposedLoraAnalyzer and SubspaceInterferenceAndMergeRouter invariants
nouns.category_reason: Defines orthogonality, 4-bit MSE suppression, column-norm DoRA decomposition and TIES routing invariants.

nouns.title: Deterministic Walsh-Hadamard outlier rotation, DoRA decomposition and TIES interference routing rules
nouns.category_reason: Zero-model mathematical procedure for low-bit quantization preparation and multi-adapter serving selection.

value.rotation_formula: W_rot = (W * diag(s)) @ H_d / sqrt(d) with s_j in {-1, +1}
value.dora_formula: W_dora[:, j] = m_j * ((W_0 + scale * B @ A)[:, j] / ||(W_0 + scale * B @ A)[:, j]||_2)

Implements WeightDecomposedLoraAnalyzer computing column-wise magnitude and directional cosine learning ratios from (B @ A) low-rank updates.
Implements SubspaceInterferenceAndMergeRouter computing flattened Frobenius cosine similarity, TIES trim-elect-merge sign-conflict density and static-vs-dynamic routing.
does_not: Perform network I/O, invoke external tensor runtimes or inline hardcoded numeric thresholds.

verbs.title: Rotate heavy-tailed channel outliers with Walsh-Hadamard transforms and evaluate low-bit quantization
verbs.summary: Apply Sylvester Walsh-Hadamard orthogonal rotations with deterministic Rademacher sign flips to disperse concentrated channel outliers before symmetric 4-bit uniform quantization.
verbs.outcome: Outlier kurtosis, max-to-RMS suppression and low-bit reconstruction MSE metrics.

slots.name: weight_bundle
slots.description: Pin of channel weight matrices and quantization grid parameters.

steps: Load quantization bit-width, granularity and rotation seed from default_grid_spec.json without inline magic numbers.
Compute Fast Walsh-Hadamard rotated weights, run symmetric uniform quantization and compare inverse-rotated reconstruction MSE against unrotated quantization.

acceptance.check: Inverse Walsh-Hadamard rotation recovers unquantized weights within numerical precision and reduces 4-bit MSE on heavy-tailed channel matrices.

verbs.title: Decompose DoRA magnitude/direction updates and route multi-adapter interference
verbs.summary: Decompose low-rank (B @ A) deltas into column magnitudes and unit-direction cosine shifts, and score adapter pairs by Frobenius cosine similarity and TIES sign-conflict density to select static fusion vs co-resident switching.
verbs.outcome: DoRA directional-to-magnitude learning metrics and interference-aware adapter serving recommendations.

slots.name: adapter_bundle
slots.description: Pin of base weights, low-rank adapter factors and candidate multi-adapter deltas.

steps: Decompose base and low-rank-updated weight columns into Euclidean magnitudes and unit directions via WeightDecomposedLoraAnalyzer.
Evaluate flattened Frobenius cosine similarity and TIES sign-conflict density across adapter pairs to select ties_static_merge or dynamic_co_resident_switch.

acceptance.check: Orthogonal non-conflicting adapters route to ties_static_merge while overlapping sign-conflicting adapters route to dynamic_co_resident_switch.
